XRPL Grants announced its new panel of judges: XRPL Grants Expands Judging Committee - DEV Community

Similar to Grant for the Web, but specific to projects that build on the XRPL, this newer grant program is currently accepting applications (the deadline is tomorrow). We have funded some projects that use (or want to use) Interledger. And we hope that some projects building on Interledger will also integrate with the XRPL (or use it for settlement under the hood).
